### POST /api/v1/inbox/inboxes

Create a team inbox

Requires `teamInbox:create` (manager+). A team inbox receives what its `sources` claim — the first team inbox in the routing order (`PUT /inbox/inboxes/order`; a new one goes last) with a matching source wins — and everything else stays with the workspace's own assignment (`/inbox/assignment`). A source needs at least one condition: account, platform, type, or keywords.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- object
  - `organizationId`: string — Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace.
  - `name`: string (max length 120), required
  - `description`: string | null (max length 500)
  - `method`: one of `"manual"` | `"round_robin"` | `"balanced"`
  - `skillsEnabled`: boolean
  - `awayReassign`: boolean
  - `rrAssignWhenAway`: boolean
  - `wrapUpMinutes`: integer (min 0, max 240)
  - `sources`: array of object (max 50 items)
    - `accountId`: string | null
    - `platform`: one of `"bluesky"` | `"twitter"` | `"threads"` | `"mastodon"` | `"facebook_page"` | `"instagram"` | `"linkedin_page"` | `null`
    - `type`: one of `"reply"` | `"mention"` | `null`
    - `keywords`: array of string | null (max 50 items)
  - `members`: array of object (max 200 items)
    - `userId`: string, required
    - `tier`: one of `"primary"` | `"secondary"`
    - `capacity`: integer | null (min 0)
    - `skills`: array of string | null

**Responses**

- `200` — The created inbox
  - `TeamInbox`
    - `id`: string, required
    - `name`: string, required
    - `description`: string | null, required
    - `method`: one of `"manual"` | `"round_robin"` | `"balanced"`, required

    - `awayReassign`: boolean, required
    - `rrAssignWhenAway`: boolean, required
    - `position`: number, required — Routing order: a new conversation goes to the first team inbox, lowest position first, with a source that matches it. Set with `PUT /inbox/inboxes/order`.

### GET /api/v1/inbox/assignment

How the workspace assigns conversations

Requires `teamInbox:read`. The method and rotation applied to every conversation no team inbox claims, plus `waitingCount` — how many open conversations have no owner. A workspace that has never changed it reads as the default: round robin across everyone.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's assignment
  - `InboxAssignment`
    - `method`: one of `"manual"` | `"round_robin"` | `"balanced"`, required
    - `allMembers`: boolean, required — The rotation is every workspace member, including people who join later. When false, `members` is the rotation.
    - `members`: array of `TeamInboxMember`, required — The named rotation. Kept while `allMembers` is on, so switching back restores it.
      - `userId`: string, required
      - `tier`: one of `"primary"` | `"secondary"`, required
      - `capacity`: number | null, required
      - `skills`: array of string | null, required
    - `rrAssignWhenAway`: boolean, required
    - `wrapUpMinutes`: number, required
    - `waitingCount`: number, required — Open conversations with no owner right now.
    - `waitingInManual`: array of object, required — Of the waiting conversations, those routing files under a manual inbox, per inbox. `POST /inbox/assignment/distribute` can't assign these; someone pulls them.
      - `inboxId`: string, required
      - `name`: string, required
      - `isWorkspace`: boolean, required — The workspace inbox itself — the workspace's assignment is manual.
      - `count`: integer, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/inbox/assignment/distribute

Hand out the conversations already waiting

Requires `teamInbox:update` (manager+). Assigns open conversations that have no owner, oldest first, through the same routing a new arrival gets — the workspace's assignment, or a team inbox's when one claims the conversation. Routing only decides a conversation when it arrives, so this is how a backlog gets owners. Up to 500 a call; `waiting` is how many still have none (a manual method, or nobody available, assigns nothing), and `waitingInManual` which of those a manual inbox holds — another call won't assign them.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- object
  - `organizationId`: string — Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace.

**Responses**

- `200` — How many were assigned, and how many still wait
  - object
    - `assigned`: integer, required
    - `waiting`: integer, required
    - `waitingInManual`: array of object, required — Of the waiting conversations, those routing files under a manual inbox, per inbox. `POST /inbox/assignment/distribute` can't assign these; someone pulls them.
      - `inboxId`: string, required
      - `name`: string, required
      - `isWorkspace`: boolean, required — The workspace inbox itself — the workspace's assignment is manual.
      - `count`: integer, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
